title: Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (RSVQA) Sample Pack
data_type: VISUALIZATION IMAGE (RGB derived from Sentinel-2 MSI)
source: RSVQA-LR Benchmark (Sylvain Lobry et al., IEEE TGRS) & ESA Copernicus Open Access Hub
license: Open Data / CC BY 4.0 / Copernicus Open Access

samples.region: Western Europe Agricultural Mosaic (RSVQA Tile ID: LR_000)
samples.question: Is it a rural or an urban area
samples.example_curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/vqa -F "file=@samples/vqa/rsvqa_sample_0.png" -F "question=Is it a rural or an urban area"

samples.region: Suburban Commercial Sector (RSVQA Tile ID: LR_001)
samples.question: What is the number of commercial buildings?
samples.example_curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/vqa -F "file=@samples/vqa/rsvqa_sample_1.png" -F "question=What is the number of commercial buildings?"

samples.region: River Basin & Wetland Fringe (RSVQA Tile ID: LR_040, Strictly Held-Out)
samples.question: What is the number of small water areas in the image?
samples.example_curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/vqa -F "file=@samples/vqa/rsvqa_sample_40.png" -F "question=What is the number of small water areas in the image?"

samples.question: Is there a river or water body present in this scene?
samples.expected_answer: Yes, a prominent water body is clearly visible in the scene.
samples.example_curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/vqa -F "file=@samples/vqa/sentinel2_lake_suburb_vqa.png" -F "question=Is there a river or water body present?"

samples.question: What type of land cover dominates this image?
samples.expected_answer: Dense vegetation and forest canopy cover dominate the image.
samples.example_curl: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/vqa -F "file=@samples/vqa/sentinel2_forest_vqa.png" -F "question=What type of land cover dominates this image?"
